item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will still be showers and thunderstorms over southern China in the next couple of days. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas of Guangdong early to midweek next week. With the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft in the latter part of next week, the weather will be mainly fine and hot over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 06/04 (Saturday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms. Visibility relatively low in some areas at first.
Temp range: 24 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
